Questions

Is RetailerOS really free?

Yes. The Free plan covers 50 bills a month, one store and the four core modules — Sales Desk, Invoices, Inventory and Clients — with no card needed and no time limit.

How long does it take to move off paper?

About ten minutes to set up the store. You can import existing stock and customers from a spreadsheet.

Will my staff be able to use it?

Every screen has Hindi labels, and Marathi, Gujarati and Tamil are supported. Each staff member can pick their own language.

What if we go over 50 bills a month?

Billing is never blocked. You can move to Shop, which covers 750 bills a month.
